title: odd-select
description: A compact choice of one option in a form: a styled native `<select>`, so the engine's own picker, keyboard, and assistive-technology support come with it. Options come from `<option>` and `<optgroup>` children, written as for a native select (`selected` marks the default), or from `options`. Where `appearance: base-select` is supported, the open picker is drawn as Oddkin's raised listbox surface with option rows; elsewhere the engine draws it.

name.description: Name submitted with the form. Reflected: a form-associated element submits under its name attribute.

error.description: Error message; marks the field invalid (custom validity) while set.

value.description: Value of the chosen option; the `value` attribute sets the default.

placeholder.description: Shown, and submitted as an empty value, until an option is chosen; with `required`, it blocks submission. Never a substitute for a label.

required.description: An option must be chosen to submit.
